Complete [[The Elusive Golemancer]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* In the laboratory south {{sic|west}} of [[Rata Sum]], survive [[Oola]]'s security measures while you locate her.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 1,500 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per [[The Elusive Golemancer#Walkthrough|The Elusive Golemancer]] quest.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;[[Zaishen Mission]]
:''"[[Vekk]] is seeking clever humans as krewe recruiters. Handsome rewards for any human who can recruit the elusive golemancer Oola to the krewe. Talk to [[Blimm]] in [[Magus Stones]] for information on how to find her."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*Although the objectives states this as a [[mission]], it is actually a [[primary quest]].
*The mission objectives say the laboratory is to the south of [[Rata Sum]]. It is actually to the west.
